Anna Avanesova founded Ada Tours and leads the company. Today she works with complex itineraries across Brazil and Latin America, VIP journeys, groups, MICE travel and requests from international travel agencies and tour operators.

A separate focus of her work is multi-country programmes, in which several countries must be connected into a single journey with a coherent itinerary and service arrangements.

When preparing a trip, Anna starts with the individual traveller: their dates, pace, interests and preferred level of service. She values flexibility within the route, personal knowledge of the region and direct contact with local culture.
